title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
Part 5 verified.

What I checked:
- CI is green on `5158439` (lint, typecheck, test, build) and the Vercel preview deployed. I also ran `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` locally on that commit: 13 test files, 139 tests pass.
- Order: `test(recorder): take full DOM snapshot (#3)` comes before `feat(recorder): take full DOM snapshot (#3)`. The implementation commit does not touch the test file, so no test was removed, skipped or loosened.
- `takeFullSnapshot(document, ctx)` uses `createEvent` from `@rewind/shared` and builds on `serializeNode` and the `Mirror`. No logic is duplicated.
- Tests: the output passes `parseEvent`, a second snapshot with the same mirror gives the same ids, ids are unique, and the realistic page fixture (header, form, list, SVG, shadow DOM, script, relative URLs) has no password, script content, `on*` attribute, masked select value or relative URL.
- ADR 0019 explains the clock on the context. `docs/decisions/README.md` and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` are updated.
- Commits are authored as the owner with the Cursor Agent co-author trailer.

One requirement was not done by the agent: the PR was left as a draft. I mark it ready as part of the final review.
